market_question: Abstract FDV above $200M one day after launch?
reasoning: Abstract is a high-profile L2 from the Pudgy Penguins ecosystem with strong VC backing and a massive NFT community. In the current crypto environment, virtually all hyped L2 and airdrop tokens launch with FDVs well above $200M. The chance of no token launch by end of 2027 is small (<5%), and conditional on launch, >$200M FDV is very likely due to early speculative volume. The market's 77.5% probability undervalues this plausibility.
evidence_points: Pudgy Penguins is a top NFT brand with millions of followers; its token launch will attract immense retail and airdrop demand.
Comparable L2 tokens (ARB, OP, ZK) all launched with multi-billion FDVs, and even low-cap meme coins often exceed $200M FDV on day one.
Abstract's parent company Igloo Inc. raised significant venture capital, and the project is actively building toward an airdrop, making a no-launch scenario unlikely before 2028.
